gen-gf-aboreto-gf-esteban: Esteban reads gently, its thin strokes barely lighter than the stems and its lowercase running big beside the capitals. Aboreto, all wide gaps and ladle-shaped bowls, sets a showier tone above that text serif.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-fauna-one: Dignified is the first word for Fauna One. Aboreto delivers hairline-against-heavy drama up top, while Fauna One keeps its shallow ascenders and tall middle band for steady, literary reading.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-glegoo: Glegoo opens its tall lowercase with big counters and curves that never quite close their mouths. Aboreto flashes sharp bright edges against fat darkness, and Glegoo simply gets on with the sentences.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-graduate: Graduate spaces its letters generously, with capitals and lowercase nearly the same height and no thick-thin shift anywhere. Over a longer passage it feels bookish and unhurried.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-halant: Halant has a faint thick-thin shift and outward-pointing terminals, with a towering x-height that gives its lines real authority. Over a long passage that reads traditional and sturdy.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-hanuman: Hanuman reads traditionally, with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on the s. Aboreto's heavy verticals and thin horizontals give it a bolder entrance, and the text serif follows quietly.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-headland-one: Dignified describes Headland One, with its well-spaced letters and gentle stroke variation. Aboreto does fat round bowls and hairline joins best, whereas Headland One does low-key, steady lines.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Hedvig Letters Serif reads with open curves and a sturdy, tall body, its upstrokes and downstrokes barely different in weight. Hedvig Letters Serif holds the page quietly while Aboreto's bold-and-hairline strokes do the shouting.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-kadwa: Heavy ink-black strokes and gossamer hairlines share every Aboreto letter, which gives the heading its commanding look. Kadwa, a serif with open curves and a large x-height, settles in below.
gen-gf-aboreto-gf-marcellus-sc: Aboreto sets fat vertical strokes joined by filament-thin connectors, and that gives the heading its expressive pull. And Marcellus SC, a text serif with a worn-charcoal softness, makes the whole thing feel literary.
